# A made-up answer key — fixture for the grader's specs

Every item below is invented (a house, not an app). No real key item belongs in the repo.

## Main list

- **A1** · the lamp switch sits far from the lamp it lights
- **A2** · the drawer handle does nothing on most shelves
- **A3** · the hallway jumps back to the door when a rug is chosen
- **A4** · the clock face reads as a wall of text
- **A5** · the window scrolls sideways
- **A6** · the shelf label hides behind the plant
- **A7** · the stairs light ignores its own switch

## Known gaps

- **B1** · the attic door has no sign

## Found only by the readers

- **S1** · the thermostat says off while it heats
